name: Leah & Anne Wangerin
description: The two eldest Wangerin siblings. Had an apartment in Potsdam that served as a gathering point for the friend group in 2015. Anne referred JD's first paid wedding shoot in June 2018 — the booking that launched JD Meyers Productions.
public_footprint:
